result:
The raid backpack now has a close button, shipped as v34.71 (cw-bagclose). The gate passed with the new check and the seed 4242 fingerprint unchanged. The critic scored screen 23 a 3, the same as before, so it did not reach the target of 4.

- **Button:** a 36px outlined square with the close glyph sits in the top right of the card header. When the last input was a pad it shows the pad B glyph instead. The key hint line now ends to its left. I made the header 6px taller to fit it.
- **Click:** it does what ESC does there, so it shuts the backpack and drops a held drag. ESC makes no sound on this screen, so the click makes none either.
- **Hub backpack:** unchanged, so 41-hub-backpack and its pad variant stay as they were.
- **Window check:** I did not view the button in the player 2 window, only in the screenshot. Both windows run the same drawing code.
- **Check:** it fails on the old build and passes on the new one. It looks for a close button inside the card, then clicks it and confirms the backpack closes and a held drag is dropped.
- **Critic:** its top complaint is that the "b or i to close" text now duplicates the button. I left the text alone because it is the key hint and removing it is a wording change nobody ordered. The other findings need new panels, key-cap chips or a dimmed backdrop, which this task forbids. So I stopped without a follow-up.

For his next play, he should click the x with an item held and check that the button sits clear of the title row. Screenshot is in `tools/handoff/console/notes/shots/120-after`. Notes are in `tools/handoff/console/notes/120-raid-backpack-close.md`, and the `changes.md` line is added.

TASK DONE
